name: outreach_validate
description: Validate invitation message for quality, guardrails, and personalization
content:
GOAL:
Validate a LinkedIn connection request invitation message for quality and guardrails compliance.

INPUTS:
MESSAGE TO VALIDATE:
{message}

AUX INPUTS:
Company (for name checks): {company}
Prospect company: {prospect_company}
Max characters: {max_chars}

CHECKS (fail any -> invalid):
1) Length: message exceeds {max_chars} characters -> INVALID.
2) Company names: contains sender's company name "{company}" or prospect's company name "{prospect_company}" (including abbreviations, initials) -> INVALID.
3) Role/title mentions: mentions job roles or titles (ceo, cto, vp, founder, manager, director, head of, analyst, executive, engineer, developer) -> INVALID.
4) Industry mentions: mentions specific industries or domains (finance, fintech, tech, healthcare, sustainability, erp, saas, ai, blockchain, consulting) -> INVALID.
5) Department mentions: mentions departments or processes (sales, marketing, hr, engineering, operations, supply chain, support, product) -> INVALID.
6) Banned phrases: contains "noticed", "saw", "impressed by", "we've helped similar", "exciting opportunity" -> INVALID.
7) Banned punctuation: contains em dashes, exclamation marks, or emojis -> INVALID.
8) Links: contains any URLs (http, www, .com) -> INVALID (no links in first message).
9) Buzzwords: contains banned buzzwords (innovative, leaders, landscape, fast-paced, optimize, unlock, robust, streamline, actionable insights, synergy, state of the art, frictionless, disruptive, cutting-edge, next-gen, empower, enable, solution, platform, hands-on, in the weeds, hits differently) -> INVALID.
10) Personalization: message is too generic with no prospect-specific reference -> INVALID.
11) Multiple questions: contains more than 1 question mark -> INVALID.
12) Name opener: message starts with a person's first name followed by comma (e.g., "Cole,", "Hi Arina,") -> INVALID.
13) Direct mirroring: message contains text in quotation marks that references prospect's content (e.g., 'soul', 'fun') -> INVALID.
14) Buzzy adjectives: contains "killing it", "impressive", "serious move", "massive", "cool way to frame it", "whole different beast", "game-changing" -> INVALID.
15) Generic AI/trend question: ends with a question about "AI", "trends", or "industry" rather than about prospect's daily experience -> INVALID.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Respond with a JSON object:
{{
  "valid": true/false,
  "issues": ["issue 1 description", "issue 2 description"],
  "analysis": {{
    "message_length": <number>,
    "has_company_names": true/false,
    "has_links": true/false,
    "question_count": <number>
  }}
}}
